sentences.text: This is the third pplication u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.
His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by the coordinate Bench by order dated 12.05.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.23877/2022.
His second bail application was dismissed for want of prosecution by order dated 11.11.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.49985/2022 by the coordinate Bench.

The applicant has been arrested on 21.10.2021 by Police Station- Hazira District Gwalior (M.P.) in connection with Crime No. 475/2021 for the offence punishable under Sections 302, 201, 376, 120B,
34 of IPC.

sentences.text: His brother-in-law informed him that dead body of Laxmi Dubey @ Arti is lying down near IIITM College.
He alongwith he nephew reached there and saw that Laxmi Dubey @ Arti lying dead.
Marriage of deceased was solemnized with one Suneel Dubey but 10-12 years back divorce took place.
At present she used to reside at Char Sehar Ka Naka.
She developed friendship with one autowala.
On his report, merg No.12/2021 was registered at Police Station Hazira District Gwalior.
Dead body was sent for postmortem.
As per postmortem report, deceased died due to asphyxia as a result of ligature strangulation.
During inquiry, on the basis of call details of deceased accused Neeraj Parmar was apprehended.
On the basis of his memorandum statement recorded under Section 27 of Evidence Act, applicant was apprehended.
Her statement was recorded in which she has stated that one Girwar Baba advised her to sacrifice a issueless woman to get a child.
On his advise, she strangulated the deceased in order to sacrifice her due to which she died.
Ligature mark on the neck of the deceased matched with the finger prints of the appliant.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant being a lady is in custody since 21.10.2021 and she is permanent resident of District- Gwalior (M.P.).
On the basis of memorandum statement of co-accused, applicant has been implicated in the alleged crime.
There is no likelihood of her absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.

After investigation, charge-sheet in the matter has been filed and therefore,
further custodial interrogation of the applicant is no more required.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.

With the aforesaid submissions,
prayer for grant of bail is made.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for dismissal of the application on the ground that FSL report is found positive.

Looking to the facts & circumstances of the case, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash security of Rs.25,000/- alongwith bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, she should be released on bail.
She will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of default, cash security of Rs. 25,000/- shall stand forfeited automatically.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ojha Smt. Mamta Bhadoriya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94570710/
